title: Heavy Cheering from Students in a School Auditorium by ElevatorFan2020
author: ElevatorFan2020
sourceDescription: A crowd of around a lot of students and some people cheering loudly and applauding, You can hear some screams from the little kids and subtle voice of someone speaking into a microphone thus being amplified with speakers during the applause. That's why I had to use De-crowd that removes the emcee's voice.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -5.80 dBFS); 30 ms fades
